output.english: This is a simulated flood alert for Richmond, VA. Flooding is causing fires and trapped people near Downtown Junction, Broad and 3rd, Shockoe Bottom, and Riverside Apartments. Avoid Dock St and Lee Bridge, do not walk or drive through floodwater, and call for help if you are in danger.
output.spanish: Este es un alerta simulada de inundación para Richmond, VA. Hay inundaciones que causan incendios y personas atrapadas cerca de Downtown Junction, Broad y 3rd, Shockoe Bottom y Riverside Apartments. Evite Dock St y Lee Bridge, no camine ni maneje en el agua, y pida ayuda si está en peligro.
